native.name: shell
native.description: Run a command in this run's runtime (native) with bash syntax. The command is a child process of this executor: an interrupt or a timeout ends its process group; processes it leaves behind after returning are not managed. Waits up to wait_ms (default 30s, max 30 min) for the command to finish; a command still running then continues as a task and this call returns its task_id with the output so far — follow up with `wait_task` / `get_task_state`. Raise wait_ms for commands you expect to take long (builds, tests). Start a long-lived service with nohup / setsid and return at once; on Unix, processes started with `&` / nohup in the foreground command's process group also end when that command is interrupted or times out. Long output keeps its beginning and end.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to or within the configured workspace. Defaults to the workspace.

wait_ms.description: How long this call waits in milliseconds before the command continues as a task (default 30000, max 1800000).

native.name: wait_task
native.description: Wait for a task to finish and return its result, or its current state and new output when wait_ms (default 30s) passes first. A wait longer than 30 minutes is only possible when the session can suspend; otherwise it is capped. Waiting never affects the task.

task_id.description: task id from an earlier result

wait_ms.description: How long to wait in milliseconds (default 30000).

native.name: get_task_state
native.description: Return a task's current state at once: its result when finished, otherwise how long it has run and the tail of its output.

task_id.description: task id from an earlier result

native.name: cancel_task
native.description: Stop a running task. Only tasks that declared themselves cancellable can be stopped; others report that cancellation is unsupported and keep running.

task_id.description: task id from an earlier result

native.name: report
native.description: Submit a progress report, or finish this context with is_end=true. Final reports require all tasks and child work to be settled. Accepted completion skips remaining calls in the batch. Artifacts are explicit files relative to the work directory; result is optional application JSON. Reports are delivered by the host, not sent as messages by this tool.
